neighbours.label: The word piece that directly follows the 'across' prefix: English 'trans' (trans|boundary, trans|ceiver, trans|mem|brane) and its Russian counterpart 'пер' (пер|ек|усить, пер|ен|ести). Whole-token trans- words (transfer, translation) and the same pieces without the prefix stay quiet.
fire: Two countries signed an accord on transboundary air pollution last year.
Each handset contains a low-power transceiver and a small antenna.
The receptor is a transmembrane protein with seven helices.
Both states share data on the transboundary aquifer beneath the desert.
По дороге домой мы успели перекусить бутербродами.
Директор попросил перенести собрание на пятницу.
Не забудь переключить телефон на беззвучный режим.
Огонь мог перекинуться на соседний сарай.
quiet: Two countries signed an accord on the transfer of prisoners last year.
Each handset contains a low-power receiver and a small antenna.
The receptor sits in the cell membrane and has seven helices.
Both states share data on the boundary that runs through the desert.
По дороге домой мы успели поесть бутербродов.
Директор попросил назначить собрание на пятницу.
Не забудь поставить телефон на беззвучный режим.
Огонь мог дойти до соседнего сарая.

notes: Probe: transboundary 0.61, transceiver 0.82, transmembrane 0.66, перекусить 0.70, перенести 0.48; 'translation … transfer' 0.00, Russian sentence without пер- 0.01. Near misses keep the sentence and swap in a whole-token trans- word, the bare piece (boundary, membrane, receiver) or a verb without пер-.
